messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — opened a docs PR with consolidated offline install steps + KMS/HSM examples. Can someone glance? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542 :eyes:

Chris L.: lgtm overall. One quick callout: in the air-gapped section we should add the apt/yum proxy and systemd-resolved gotcha. Want me to drop a small snippet?

Maria G.: yes please, adding an apt-proxy snippet would help. Also docs-bot flagged a dead link to our old HSM vendor page — I couldn't find the updated replacement.

docs-bot: linkcheck: Broken link found in docs/offline/install.md line 88 -> https://example.com/old-hsm-guide

Ankur: Sharing a minimal apt proxy + offline fetch approach I used for a customer (keeps examples tiny):
```
# /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy
Acquire::http::Proxy "http://10.0.0.2:3142";
```
Also, for packaging offline .deb files:
```
# on a bastion with internet
apt-get --print-uris -y upgrade | awk -F"'" '{print $2}' > urls.txt
xargs -n1 -P8 curl -O < urls.txt
# tar up the .debs and /var/lib/apt/lists for the target hosts
```

Chris L.: For KMS/HSM integration, add a brief PKCS#11 config example and a systemd unit to ensure the HSM agent starts before the runtime:
```
[Unit]
Description=HSM agent
Before=redwood-runtime.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hsm-agent --config /etc/hsm/config.yaml
Restart=on-failure
```
Add a note that the HSM socket path must match the value in the runtime `hsm:` section.

Maria G.: Good call. I'll include the config key name in the snippet. Also we need a migration blurb about rotating keys when moving from 1.2 -> 1.3 without implying data loss.

Jen S.: Quick policy note: don't tell users to `rm` keyfiles. Recommend using `redwood key rotate --preserve-old` and explain rollback steps. I left a comment on the PR with suggested wording.

Chris L.: :thumbsup: Small editorial: the private VPC CIDR example used 10.0.0.0/8 which is too permissive for our templates — switched it to 10.96.0.0/12 in the PR and added an inline justification.

Maria G.: awesome, thanks. I'll re-run linkcheck and merge after one more approval.

docs-bot: linkcheck: No broken links found.

Ankur: FYI I added a tiny note about disabling systemd-resolved on some Ubuntu versions in airgapped setups — that saved two support tickets last month.

Maria G.: added that note. merging in ~30m unless objections.

Chris L.: no objections from me.

Jen S.: :rocket:
